messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: 2 critical alerts for inference-pool-usw-1 — multiple nodes entering NotReady + kubelet restarts (alert: KUBE_NODE_NOTREADY_SURGE)

sarah_w: saw it. swapping to pager, i'm oncall. investigating now.

miguel_r: +1, i'll stand by for handoff if it escalates. any customer reports?

jun_park: i'm seeing spike in 503s in logs for /v1/generate from app-proxy, ~2.8% error rate starting 13:36 UTC. linking grafana -> https://grafana/redwood/d/v1/inference-latency

alice_p: adding infra traces — route weight fallback triggered to eu-west for some traffic, but capacity limited.

sarah_w: ok first check: kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-usw -o wide

```
ip-10-0-5-12   Ready  <none>  2h   v1.26.3  gpu-rtx  kubelet: NotReady
ip-10-0-7-21   Ready  <none>  4h   v1.26.3  gpu-rtx
ip-10-0-9-05   NotReady  <none>  40m  v1.26.3  gpu-rtx  kubelet: Restarting
```

sarah_w: multiple NotReady and one node restarting kubelet in loop. suspect kubelet crash on that node.

ben_dev: can we get `kubectl describe node ip-10-0-5-12` and `journalctl -u kubelet -n 200` from node? I can ssh if needed.

sarah_w: copying outputs, attaching kernel/cuda errors from journalctl:

```
May 14 13:35:02 ip-10-0-5-12 kubelet[1234]: E0514 13:35:02 kubelet.go:234] runtime service error: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = containerd: containerd: process killed due to OOM
May 14 13:35:03 ip-10-0-5-12 dockerd[998]: time="..." level=error msg="failed to start containerd task: exit status 137"
May 14 13:35:04 ip-10-0-5-12 kernel: [drm] NVRM: GPU HANG: Xid 79, pid=0, GPU=00000000:65:00.0
```

miguel_r: Xid 79 + exit 137 -> looks like GPU driver hang followed by container OOM/killed. Could be interplay between driver and driver plugin causing kubelet to restart.

ops_shift: rerouting: setting route rule so that inference-usw weight -> 30% for canary, rest to eu-west. watch latency.

alice_p: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector=status.phase!=Running` to list failing pods

```
inference-abc-0  CrashLoopBackOff   node=ip-10-0-5-12
inference-def-1  Error              node=ip-10-0-5-12
```

ben_dev: logs from failing pod show CUDA driver errors and then OOM: `RuntimeError: cudart: unknown error` and `Killed process 4567 (runner) total-vm:...`

sarah_w: immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain the loop-restarting node, 2) trigger node reboot after drain, 3) bump inference dedicated pool for 30 mins to absorb load, 4) update routing fallback TTL.

jun_park: agree. I'll start drain now.

jun_park: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-5-12` -> OK

jun_park: `kubectl drain ip-10-0-5-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` -> some pods evicted, some failed due to GPU resource scheduling. fallback pods launched in eu-west but some pending due to quota.

alice_p: I've requested burst capacity in dedicated pool (infra autoscale override) +50% for 20 minutes, PR submitted to infra-ops. infra-ci-bot: autoscale request https://internal/requests/3456 (approved)

infra-ci-bot: Autoscale change applied: inference-dedicated-usw scaled from 6 -> 9 instances (GPU).

miguel_r: after cordon/drain we should reboot the node to clear driver state. i'll SSH and run `sudo systemctl reboot` once pods are drained.

ben_dev: before reboot, can we capture /var/log/nvidia-installer and dmesg outputs and push to S3 for postmortem?

sarah_w: done. logs uploaded -> s3://redwood-incident-logs/2351234567/ node-5-12-logs.tar.gz

ops_shift: traffic is stabilizing, error rate dropped to 0.7% now, latency back within 95th percentile but tail still elevated.

jun_park: rebooted node at 13:46 UTC. kubelet came back up at 13:49, but node briefly flapped NotReady -> Ready. monitoring for 10m to ensure stability.

sarah_w: kubelet logs after reboot show driver reset and then successful health checks. no immediate OOMs. evidence points to intermittent GPU driver hang causing container runtime to OOM/kill and then kubelet lifecycle issues.

alice_p: post-reboot we had 3 pods stuck pending due to GPU allocation; they were placed on other healthy nodes after autoscale.

ben_dev: I'll open a bug with driver vendor with logs including Xid 79 traces + kernel oops. tagging with reproduction snippets.

miguel_r: customer impact summary for pager: impact window 13:35-13:52 UTC, ~2.8% 503s peak, affected region: us-west-1 inference pool; mitigations: cordon+drain, autoscale burst to dedicated pool, routing fallback to eu-west. No data loss.

oncall-bot: Incident assigned -> INC-2026-2351234567. Severity: P2. Postmortem required.

sarah_w: handing off to miguel for follow-up and postmortem. i'm going off shift. can you own write-up and vendor escalation?

miguel_r: taking it. will draft postmortem, include trigger hypothesis (GPU driver hang -> container OOM -> kubelet restart), mitigation steps, and long-term actions: pin driver version, add GPU-driver healthcheck + node fencing automation, and increase cross-region capacity slack.

alice_p: add runbook note: if Xid 79 observed, temporarily fence node and force driver restart before kubelet restart to prevent cascading pod OOMs.

ops_shift: closing immediate mitigation - monitoring for 1h. open to handoff.

miguel_r: thanks team. filing postmortem and vendor ticket. linking after draft: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-2351234567

sarah_w: thanks all :heart: 

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2351234567 marked 'mitigated' at 13:52 UTC.
